column7: The Abyssal Sire is an abyssal demon Slayer boss that requires level 85 Slayer to kill.
The Alchemical Hydra is a boss version of hydra, found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm, requiring level 95 Slayer to kill.
Amoxliatl is a powerful Frost Nagua found within the Ruins of Tapoyauik, who serves as its guardian and is fought during The Heart of Darkness as the final fight of the quest.
Araxxor is the boss version of araxytes found in an instanced lair inside the Morytania Spider Cave, requiring level 92 Slayer and access to Morytania to kill.
The Barrows is a series of six burial mounds east of Mort'ton in which the Barrows brothers were entombed after their deaths during the Third Age.
Brutus is a low-level free-to-play boss first fought in The Ides of Milk quest.
Bryophyta (, ), the Moss Giantess, is an ancient and mystical moss giant boss who can be found in her lair in the Varrock Sewers.
Callisto is an enormous bear empowered by the corruption of the Wilderness that resides in Callisto's Den at level 40 Wilderness and is the one of two monsters to drop the tyrannical ring.

Cerberus is a level 318 hellhound boss who resides in Cerberus' Lair, deep beneath the Taverley Dungeon in the cave entrance in the north-east part of the hellhound area, which is found beyond the poisonous spiders.
The Chaos Elemental is a dark cloud with six tentacles that dwells in the members-only section of the Wilderness, just west of the Rogues' Castle.
The Chaos Fanatic is a relatively simple boss that resides west of the Lava Maze in level 42 Wilderness, surrounded by miniature chaotic clouds that serve as unattackable scenery.

Commander Zilyana is the appointed leader of Saradomin's forces in the God Wars Dungeon and one of only three known still living representatives of the Icyene race, one being the half-human half-Icyene Safalaan and the other being a full-blooded Icyene encountered during the quest The Blood Moon Ris
The Corporeal Beast, often referred to simply as Corp, is a large monster residing in its lair, accessed via the games necklace or an entrance in level 21 Wilderness.
Bellock, the crazy archaeologist, is a relatively simple boss that resides in the ruins south of The Forgotten Cemetery within level 23 Wilderness.
Dagannoth Rex is the Melee-based Dagannoth King found in the depths of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Prime.
The Deranged archaeologist is a relatively simple boss that resides at the southern end of the Tar Swamp on Fossil Island.

The Doom of Mokhaiotl, also referred to as Osto-Ayak, is a giant insect-like, demonic boss found in the Ruins of Mokhaiotl, which is accessed during The Final Dawn quest, deep beneath the Tlati Rainforest.
Duke Sucellus (pronounced ) is a chthonian demon sealed in Ghorrock Prison, who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.
The TzHaar Fight Cave, commonly referred to as the Fight Caves, is a combat minigame in the outer area of Mor Ul Rek, located within the Karamja volcano.
The Fortis Colosseum is a large stadium found on the cliffs east of Civitas illa Fortis.

The Gauntlet is a solo minigame in Prifddinas in which the player is given a limited amount of time to explore a randomly generated dungeon layout, gather various resources and supplies by skilling and defeating crystalline monsters, all in preparation to defeat the Crystalline Hunllef, which is bas
General Graardor is the leader of Bandos' forces within the God Wars Dungeon.
The Giant Mole (Talpidae wysonian) is a relatively simple boss found in the Mole Hole under Falador Park.
The Grotesque Guardians are a pair of gargoyles, Dusk and Dawn, found on the Slayer Tower's rooftop, whose entrance is found on the.
The Hespori is a sporadic Farming boss fought in the cave within the west wing of the Farming Guild which requires to access.
The Hueycoatl is a draconic boss whose large body is coiled around the Darkfrost.
The Inferno is a solo minigame that was added to Old School RuneScape on the 1 June 2017, along with an update to the city of Mor Ul Rek.
The Kalphite Queen (Kalphiscarabeinae pasha), also called the KQ, is the strongest of the Kalphites.
The King Black Dragon, commonly referred to as KBD, is a three-headed dragon located in his lair, accessible only through the deep Wilderness.
The Kraken is a stronger and larger version of the cave kraken.
Kree'arra is one of Armadyl's most trusted generals.
K'ril Tsutsaroth (pronounced ) is the leader of Zamorak's forces in the God Wars Dungeon.
The Leviathan is a large sea creature found within the Scar, who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.
The Mad Angel is a golem boss found in Ardeaglais, a cathedral on the island of Wyrmscraig.
The Maggot King is a boss in Vampyrium that requires completion of The Blood Moon Rises to kill.
The Moons of Peril are three nagua bosses imprisoned in Neypotzli, a prison located beneath Cam Torum.
Nex is one of Zaros' most powerful followers.
The Nightmare of Ashihama, often referred to as The Nightmare, is a boss monster located in Morytania.
Obor, the Hill Titan, is the hill giant boss residing in his lair, located behind the locked gates found at the western wall of the hill giant area in the Edgeville Dungeon.
The Phantom Muspah is a boss first fought as the Strange Creature during the Secrets of the North quest.
The Royal Titans are a boss encounter consisting of the two giants Eldric the Ice King and Branda the Fire Queen.
Sarachnis, the mother of the temple spiders, is a mid-level boss found in the Forthos Dungeon, in a former burial tomb south of the Spider Den.
Scorpia is a large female scorpion boss that resides in a cave beneath the Scorpion Pit located in Wilderness level 53-55.
Scurrius, the Rat King is a boss residing in the Varrock Sewers.
The shellbane gryphon is the boss version of gryphons found in a cave in the centre of the Great Conch, requiring level 51 Slayer and completion of Troubled Tortugans to kill.
Skotizo is a demonic boss located beneath the Catacombs of Kourend.
Tempoross is a cooperative minigame-style boss that is fought using skills rather than combat.
The thermonuclear smoke devil, often referred to as thermy, is the boss version of the smoke devil.
Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis was a Ghrazi vampyre whose corpse is found in the Stranglewood Ritual Site, animated by the Strangler parasite.
Venenatis is a large spider that resides in the Silk Chasm, at level 35 Wilderness.
Vet'ion (pronounced ) is a Zamorakian skeletal champion that resides in Vet'ion's Rest, at level 35 Wilderness.
Vorkath (roughly translated as pathetic failure/weakling/runt in the dragonkin's language) is a draconic boss-monster first encountered during the Dragon Slayer II quest as the penultimate boss.
The Whisperer is a siren found in the sunken cathedral of the Lassar Undercity, who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.
The Wintertodt is a cooperative minigame-style boss that is fought using skills rather than combat.
Yama, the Master of Pacts is a powerful demonic duo-focused boss who dwells in Yama's Domain found in the depths of the Chasm of Fire.
Zalcano is a demon imprisoned beneath Prifddinas that is fought using skilling rather than conventional combat.
Zulrah is a level 725 solo-only snake boss.
The Chambers of Xeric is a raid located within a sprawling cave system beneath Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands.
The Fractured Archive is the fourth raid in Old School RuneScape, released on 20 October 2026.
The Theatre of Blood is a raid located beneath the castle of Ver Sinhaza.
The Tombs of Amascut is a raid set in the Kharidian Desert, within the Jaltevas Pyramid at the necropolis.
A clue scroll (beginner) is a random drop from a large variety of lower-levelled monsters and certain skilling activities.
Easy clue scrolls can be between 2 and 4 steps long.
Medium clue scrolls can be between 3 and 5 steps long.
Hard clue scrolls can be between 4 and 6 steps long, and are longer, more dangerous, and have harder requirements than previous tiers of clues.
Elite clue scrolls can be between 5 and 7 steps long, and have harder requirements than previous tiers of clues.
Master clue scrolls can be between 6 and 8 steps long, and are much longer, more dangerous, and have higher requirements than all other tiers of clues.
Scroll cases increase the total combined number clue scrolls/scroll boxes that a player can hold in their inventory/bank upon opening.
Barbarian Assault is a combat minigame played in the basement of the Barbarian Outpost.
Barracuda Trials are a series of Sailing activities.
The Brimhaven Agility Course is an Agility-training minigame located beneath Brimhaven.
Castle Wars is a free-to-play combat minigame similar to, but with a Old School RuneScape twist.
Fishing Trawler is a Fishing minigame in which players must prevent Murphy's trawling boat from sinking for five minutes.
Giants' Foundry is a Smithing minigame in which players are tasked with creating giant weapons for Kovac.
Gnome Restaurant, known by the gnomes as Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service, is a minigame that involves Gnome cooking, and delivering your creations to various customers as quickly as possible.
Guardians of the Rift is a non-combat minigame that takes place within the Temple of the Eye.

The Hallowed Sepulchre is an Agility minigame set in an ancient Saradominist burial ground of the city Hallowvale, located beneath Darkmeyer available to players with level 52 Agility and completion of Sins of the Father.
Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing is the Last Man Standing reward store owned by Justine located in the Last Man Standing lobby.
The Mage Training Arena is a Magic minigame located to the north of the Emir's Arena.
Mahogany Homes is a Construction minigame in which players complete contracts for various NPCs throughout Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne, and Hosidius.
Mastering Mixology is a Herblore minigame located in Aldarin.
Pest Control is a co-operative combat-based minigame, in which players defend the Void Knight from an onslaught of pests, while also destroying the portals from which the monsters spawn.
The Rogues' Den is a hideout located beneath a trapdoor in The Toad and Chicken inn in Burthorpe, containing a variety of Thieving and Agility related activities.
Shades of Mort'ton is a combat and skilling minigame that takes place in Mort'ton.
Soul Wars is a members-only team minigame, a remake of the original released in RuneScape 2 on 10 February 2009.

Temple Trekking is a members-only minigame in which the player must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to the Paterdomus, the temple on River Salve, on the way guiding them through the swamp while defending them from dangerous packs of monsters, some unique to this m
The Tithe Farm is a Farming based minigame that is located in Hosidius, requiring level 34 Farming to play.
Trouble Brewing is a minigame that takes place on the east side of the pirate island of Mos Le'Harmless.
Vale Totems is a Fletching minigame found in Auburn Valley in the north western part of Varlamore.
The Volcanic Mine is a large volcanic chamber found underneath the Fossil Island Volcano.
Aerial fishing is a hybrid Fishing and Hunter technique requiring levels 35 Hunter and 43 Fishing.
A pet is a non-combat NPC loyal to a player that is generally obtained from monster drops and skilling.
Boat paints are trims that can be applied to boats.
The Ruins of Camdozaal is a ruined underground city which was once the home of the Imcando dwarves after the fall of Imcandoria.
The Champions' Challenge is a Distraction and Diversion found in the basement of the Champions' Guild.
Chompy bird hunting is an unmarked Ranged activity that involves killing chompy and jubbly birds.

column7: The Colossal Wyrm Agility Course is an Agility course found in the Avium Savannah which involves running around the scaffolding that surrounds the Colossal Wyrm Remains.
Creature Creation is a solo activity that involves creating unique hybrid monsters and killing them for their drops.
A cyclops (plural cyclopes) is a large one-eyed giant.
Elder Chaos druids are high-level mages found at the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness.
Forestry: The Way of the Forester is a social-focused expansion to core Woodcutting.
The House on the Hill is a location on Fossil Island.
Demonic gorillas are powerful creatures found in the Crash Site Cavern.
The Hunter Guild is a members-only guild located within the north-western part of the Avium Savannah, just outside Civitas illa Fortis.
Lost schematics are unique items that unlock recipes for high-level shipbuilding parts, for use in the Sailing skill.
The Ape Atoll Agility Course is an Agility training area located near Marim, available to players with level 48 Agility (cannot be boosted).
The Motherlode Mine is a low-intensity members-only Mining training area located in the Dwarven Mine.
My notes is a book given during the Barbarian Training miniquest by Otto Godblessed.
Ocean encounters are events that appear randomly while Sailing, offering small rewards and Sailing experience.
Random events, anti-macro events, or simply randoms refers to a variety of NPCs and their associated areas that appear throughout Gielinor to interact with players.
Revenants are the ghostly versions of creatures slain during the God Wars found in the Revenant Caves within the Wilderness in levels 19 to 40.
The Rooftop Agility Courses are a set of agility courses that were added to Old School RuneScape on 5 December 2013.
The combat ring is an arena in the Shayzien Encampment.
Dusuri's Star Shop is a store owned by Dusuri, who can be found by the Mining Guild entrance in Falador.
